newsitem.title: USA: NMC Corp says to buy Canal Jean Co.
newsitem.headline: NMC Corp says to buy Canal Jean Co.

text.p: NMC Corp said Monday it plans to buy Canal Jean Co Inc, a retail clothing department store in New York City's Soho district.
NMC said it will acquire all of the outstanding shares of Canal Jean for 5 million shares of NMC common stock.
NMC said Canal Jean will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary.
NMC said Canal Jean plans to include a private label, licensing and the development of the retail clothing department store in other locations.

The company also said Canal Jean plans to its expand its existing retail splace in Soho in 1997 by an additional 15,000 square feet. It currently uses 50,000 square feet in the 100,000 square foot building it occupies.
NMC said Canal Jean had gross sales in fiscal 1996 of about $16 million and a net profit of about $1 million.
